Install Stage 1 reactor coil_row12 (10 mL, 2.4 mm ID, ETFE) at 95 deg C.
Install Stage 2 reactor coil_row11 (5 mL, 2.4 mm ID, ETFE) at 95 deg C.
Install assigned feeds A:pump_e_series_blue, B:pump_e_series_blue.
Set the outlet BPR to 7 bar gauge and start liquid feeds at final outlet flow 0.1 mL/min.
post_reactor_steps: Effluent from Stage 2 reactor passes through the 7 bar BPR and is collected at ambient temperature. No inline quench required (Chemistry Plan: quench_required = false). Workup proceeds offline per batch protocol.
Collect only after the canonical residence-time stabilization period; use the inventory-compiled downstream path.
Collect only after the canonical residence-time stabilization period; use the inventory-compiled downstream path.
For shutdown, stop reactive cofeeds and reagent gas first, flush with a compatible declared solvent, then depressurize through the controlled outlet.

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

uncertainties: specific uncertainty

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

uncertainties: specific uncertainty

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

    "answer": "This is a two-stage DPDTC-mediated amide formation through a thioester intermediate. calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 17.9 min (ratio 0.60) and S2 hold 14.3 min (ratio 0.48) are both well below batch anchors with no kinetic justification. Under yield-priority policy, both stages carry meaningful under-exposure risk for an uncharacterized reaction. Too short to serve as a credible starting point.
uncertainties: S1 thioester conversion adequacy at 17.9 min entirely unknown.
S2 aminolysis completeness at 14.3 min unknown.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 16.7 min (ratio 0.56) is modestly short but S2 hold 33.3 min (ratio 1.11) exceeds batch anchor — appropriate for yield-priority given S2 aminolysis is the product-forming step. PFA 2 mL coil (S1) and ETFE 5 mL (S2) are correctly rated. Practical flow rates. Well-balanced exploratory starting point per objective.
uncertainties: S1 conversion at 16.7 min sub-batch — thioester yield feeding S2 unknown.
Stream B 2.1 M benzylamine solubility unconfirmed.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 35.7 min (ratio 1.19) exceeds batch anchor — supports high thioester conversion before amine addition. S2 hold 14.3 min (ratio 0.48) is sub-batch but aminolysis with benzylamine may be fast; this asymmetry is a reasonable exploratory hypothesis under yield priority. Higher throughput than C2.
uncertainties: S2 aminolysis completeness at 14.3 min unverified — could limit final amide yield.
Extended S1 thioester stability at 95 °C uncharacterized.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 31.3 min (ratio 1.04) and S2 25.0 min (ratio 0.83) bracket the batch anchors closely in both stages. Both ETFE 5 mL coils at 95 °C. Balanced near-batch design is a strong yield-priority anchor; S2 slightly sub-batch is acceptable as a starting screen point.
uncertainties: S2 at 25 min sub-batch; aminolysis extent unconfirmed.
ETFE 5 mL coil used twice — inventory quantity is 2, permissible.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 25.0 min (ratio 0.83) slightly sub-batch; S2 50.0 min (ratio 1.67) substantially exceeds anchor. Yield-priority rationale for extended S2 is plausible if aminolysis is slow, but prolonged 95 °C exposure in S2 carries untested degradation risk. Informative but not the preferred starting design.
uncertainties: S1 thioester conversion adequacy at 25 min unverified.
S2 product degradation risk at 50 min/95 °C uncharacterized.

calls.system: You are a FlowPilot council reviewer. Return JSON only with concise evidence-based justification, not hidden reasoning. Authority: measured evidence > hard constraints > protocol facts > hypotheses > inference. These are unvalidated experimental SCREENS, not proven processes. Do not invent conversion, yield, kinetics, or residence-time superiority. No global shortest-time objective, 30% conversion floor, or class intensification factor. Batch residence times are screening anchors, not guaranteed flow optima. Review the COMPLETE connected process. Apply the explicit objective_policy to preferences. Near-batch times are not inherently the best choice. For yield priority compare adequate exposure in ALL stages against longer-time degradation risks, especially at a lower temperature. For throughput priority distinguish feed throughput from unmeasured product throughput. For gas stages, gas_flow_sccm and Q_gas_sccm mean mL/min at inlet/STP (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar). Their apparent residence-time index is V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP), not measured liquid residence or photon exposure. Gas equivalents are proposed delivered molar ratios, not established stoichiometric consumption or uptake. If source_context.gas_delivery.requires_chemist_confirmation is true, explicitly report the gas-source change as unapproved and requiring laboratory review before use. Irradiation sources and wavelengths must be stage-assigned; no optical intensification or light-dose adequacy is proven. Use computed_comparisons for quantitative statements: target multipliers are not actual achieved hold ratios. Do not call unequal achieved ratios symmetric or claim highest throughput without checking all candidates. Honor equipment_boundary and scope: a union is not a T-mixer; an untested cooling hypothesis does not remove a hard constraint. State reduced-temperature compensation and comparative degradation risk as untested hypotheses, never established facts. Account for temperature deviations, later feed dilution and addition order, equipment and unanswered safety/solubility issues. Do not rewrite candidate numbers. A hard violation vetoes a candidate; an unresolved experimental outcome is an uncertainty, not proof of failure. Keep each candidate justification under 45 words and each uncertainty under 20 words. Use a shared assessment for issues common to all candidates.

computed_comparisons.batch_total_excludes: Cooling, charging, workup and other handling time are excluded from the summed reaction holds.
computed_comparisons.scope: These twelve screens vary stage-time coordinates and compatible reactor geometry within the upstream topology. They do not compare cooled versus direct interstage transfer and do not optimize gas equivalents. A gas-stage inlet/STP time ratio is not a ratio of liquid exposure to batch exposure.
computed_comparisons.equipment_boundary: A two-port union is not a three-port T-mixer. An assumed_standard_accessory mixer is a separate unconfirmed item, not a confirmed union capability.
computed_comparisons.evidence_boundary: Computed feed throughput is not measured product throughput. No measured time-temperature compensation, yield or comparative degradation ranking is available.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 17.9 min (ratio 0.60) and S2 hold 14.3 min (ratio 0.48) are both well below batch anchors with no kinetic justification. Under yield-priority policy, both stages carry meaningful under-exposure risk for an uncharacterized reaction. Too short to serve as a credible starting point.
uncertainties: S1 thioester conversion adequacy at 17.9 min entirely unknown.
S2 aminolysis completeness at 14.3 min unknown.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 16.7 min (ratio 0.56) is modestly short but S2 hold 33.3 min (ratio 1.11) exceeds batch anchor — appropriate for yield-priority given S2 aminolysis is the product-forming step. PFA 2 mL coil (S1) and ETFE 5 mL (S2) are correctly rated. Practical flow rates. Well-balanced exploratory starting point per objective.
uncertainties: S1 conversion at 16.7 min sub-batch — thioester yield feeding S2 unknown.
Stream B 2.1 M benzylamine solubility unconfirmed.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 hold 35.7 min (ratio 1.19) exceeds batch anchor — supports high thioester conversion before amine addition. S2 hold 14.3 min (ratio 0.48) is sub-batch but aminolysis with benzylamine may be fast; this asymmetry is a reasonable exploratory hypothesis under yield priority. Higher throughput than C2.
uncertainties: S2 aminolysis completeness at 14.3 min unverified — could limit final amide yield.
Extended S1 thioester stability at 95 °C uncharacterized.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 31.3 min (ratio 1.04) and S2 25.0 min (ratio 0.83) bracket the batch anchors closely in both stages. Both ETFE 5 mL coils at 95 °C. Balanced near-batch design is a strong yield-priority anchor; S2 slightly sub-batch is acceptable as a starting screen point.
uncertainties: S2 at 25 min sub-batch; aminolysis extent unconfirmed.
ETFE 5 mL coil used twice — inventory quantity is 2, permissible.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 25.0 min (ratio 0.83) slightly sub-batch; S2 50.0 min (ratio 1.67) substantially exceeds anchor. Yield-priority rationale for extended S2 is plausible if aminolysis is slow, but prolonged 95 °C exposure in S2 carries untested degradation risk. Informative but not the preferred starting design.
uncertainties: S1 thioester conversion adequacy at 25 min unverified.
S2 product degradation risk at 50 min/95 °C uncharacterized.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 62.5 min (ratio 2.08) is 2× batch anchor — plausible for ensuring full thioester conversion but carries untested intermediate degradation risk. S2 25.0 min (ratio 0.83) is sub-batch. Useful for mapping S1 long-hold sensitivity but less well-justified than C3/C4 for a starting design.
uncertainties: Thioester stability at 62.5 min/95 °C uncharacterized.
S2 aminolysis extent at 25 min unconfirmed.

DrChemistry.justification: S1 62.5 min (ratio 2.08) and S2 50.0 min (ratio 1.67) both exceed batch anchors substantially. Uses two ETFE 10 mL coils — inventory has 2 units, permissible. uncertainties: Both stages carry untested intermediate/product degradation risk at 95 °C.

uncertainties: ETFE-to-PFA transition at S2 mixer — connection compatibility requires lab confirmation.
Same degradation risk as C7/C9.
